messages:
incident-bot: PAGED @oncall — High-level alert: billing metering lag detected (token count spike vs expected). Flagging potential duplicate emitter events.

alice: acked. seeing customer overage emails start ~10m ago. digging into inflight counts.

ben: quick note — metric spikes line up with a deploy to emitter-service @ 1771234200, looks suspicious.

alice: running quick query now:

```
SELECT window_start, SUM(tokens) as tokens FROM metering_events
WHERE window_start >= '2026-03-17T02:00:00Z' AND source = 'edge-emitter'
GROUP BY window_start ORDER BY window_start DESC LIMIT 6;
-- result: windows with ~2x tokens for 02:10-02:25 UTC vs baseline
```

alice: example: expected ~1.07M tokens, returned 2.15M for 02:15 window.

carol: CS is getting pinged. I'll draft a temporary notification and offer provisional credits for affected customers while we triage. @cs-lead do you want to handle outbound?

cs-lead: got it, on it. I'll coordinate a short note + credits for any customer with >50% delta. Please label affected customers in the spreadsheet.

ben: mitigation idea: flip emitter dedupe flag (feature gate) to false to force strict dedupe, or rollback emitter deploy. Which is faster?

alice: flip feature gate is quick (no deploy). command below to flip the gate in k8s configmap:

```
kubectl -n prod patch configmap/emitter-flags --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/dedupe","value":"true"}]'
```

ben: doing the gate flip now.

incident-bot: action logged by alice at 1771234900: feature-gate toggled -> dedupe=true.

alice: gate flip applied. watching token emission metrics and downstream aggregator. initial tail shows counts dropping back toward baseline but lag in reports persists.

dinesh: I'll take over live for the next hour to monitor reconciliation jobs and restart a few emitter pods if we see duplicate replay. handing off now. @alice handing to @dinesh.

dinesh: confirmed. restarting emitter pods (graceful) to clear any in-memory duplicate queues:

```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/emitter-service
```

erin: scheduled reconciliation job (reconcile-usage) queued at 1771239000, will start in ~30m. once it runs, it should dedupe historical duplicates and update billing counts. Monitor for negative corrections.

carol: CS drafted the customer note and credit policy, shared with leadership. sending now.

cs-lead: notification sent to the small set of customers impacted (IDs attached). offered credits and ETA for reconciliation results. asking for any customers with urgent SLA impact to escalate to me.

alice: summary/tracking: 1) gated dedupe true (immediate mitigation), 2) emitter pods restarted (in-progress), 3) reconcile job scheduled, 4) CS notified and credits offered. Next: observe reconciliation output and prepare backfill if needed.

ben: logging a short postmortem stub and tagging for deeper follow-up (root cause: deploy + race in emitter dedupe handshake).

incident-bot: incident severity updated -> P2 at 1771235400.

dinesh: leaving active watch to @erin for reconcile results, I'll stay on-call if anything needs manual rollback.

erin: reconcile job finished at 1771240200. outputs show ~98% of duplicates deduped, billing deltas corrected to within 3% for affected customers.

cs-lead: customers updated with reconciliation results and final credits applied. closing the immediate customer-impact loop.

alice: thanks all. will open a full incident report with timeline, root cause analysis, and follow-ups: emitter dedupe tests + deployguard.

ben: +1. please link any dashboards used to the report.

carol: handing off to postmortem queue. closing this channel for active paging. :white_check_mark:
